snippet.title: Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure -- Chapter 23: Empire of Ice
snippet.description:
Read the description!

***
Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure [Wii] playthrough, with commentary
Chapter 23
Empire of Ice

The Adventure Packs contain a new area (additional chapter) in the game, a Skylander, and two Magic Items. The Empire of Ice includes Slam Bam, Anvil Rain, and the Hylian--I mean, Sky-Iron Shield.

The Ice Ogres have taken over Haldor's village. Your task is to get rid of the Ice Ogres and other enemies, and eventually gather parts of a catapult to destroy a wall built by the Ogres.

Enjoy!
